name: server.R
content:
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  output$vbox <- renderUI({
    hc <- hchart(df, "area", hcaes(x, y), name = "Lines of code") %>%
      hc_size(height = 100) %>%
      hc_credits(enabled = FALSE) %>%
      hc_add_theme(hc_theme_sparkline_vb())

    value_box(
      title = "LINES OF CODE WRITTEN",
      value = "1,345",
      div(HTML("↑"), " 25% since last day"),
      showcase = hc,
      showcase_layout = showcase_bottom(max_height = "110px"),
      theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#47475c", fg = "#ffffff")
    )
  })

  output$vbox2 <- renderUI({
    hc <- hchart(df, "line", hcaes(x, y), name = "Distance") %>%
      hc_size(height = 100) %>%
      hc_credits(enabled = FALSE) %>%
      hc_add_theme(hc_theme_sparkline_vb())

    value_box(
      title = "DISTANCE TRAVELED",
      value = "1,345 KM",
      div(HTML("↑"), " 25% since last month"),
      showcase = hc,
      showcase_layout = showcase_bottom(max_height = "110px"),
      theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#676780", fg = "#ffffff")
    )
  })

  output$vbox3 <- renderUI({
    hc <- hchart(df, "column", hcaes(x, y), name = "Daily amount") %>%
      hc_size(height = 100) %>%
      hc_credits(enabled = FALSE) %>%
      hc_add_theme(hc_theme_sparkline_vb())

    value_box(
      title = "THINKING TIME",
      value = "1.3 HRS.",
      div(HTML("↑"), " 5% since last year"),
      showcase = hc,
      showcase_layout = showcase_bottom(max_height = "110px"),
      theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#a3edba", fg = "#313143")
    )
  })

  output$chart1 <- renderHighchart({
    highcharts_demo() %>%
      hc_add_theme(hc_theme_hcrt())
  })

  output$chart2 <- renderHighchart({
    highcharts_demo() %>%
      hc_add_theme(hc_theme_smpl())
  })
})

name: ui.R
content:
page_fluid(
  title = "Highcharter sparklines in value boxes",
  theme = app_theme,
  h2("Highcharter sparklines in value boxes"),
  p("Compact charts embedded in modern bslib value boxes."),
  layout_columns(
    col_widths = c(4, 4, 4),
    uiOutput("vbox"),
    uiOutput("vbox2"),
    uiOutput("vbox3")
  ),
  layout_columns(
    col_widths = c(6, 6),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Highcharter theme"),
      highchartOutput("chart1")
    ),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Simple theme"),
      highchartOutput("chart2")
    )
  )
)

name: DESCRIPTION
content:
Title: Highcharter Sparklines in Value Boxes
Description: Embed compact Highcharter charts inside modern bslib value boxes.
Categories: dashboards, sparklines, layout

name: Readme.md
content:
This example places small Highcharter charts inside modern `bslib::value_box()` components.

The sparkline charts use compact dimensions, simplified axes, and dedicated themes so they work as supporting indicators rather than full-size visualizations.

The page also uses `layout_columns()` and `card()` to provide a responsive dashboard layout without depending on `shinydashboard`.

name: global.R
content:
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(highcharter)

app_theme <- bs_theme(
  version = 5,
  bootswatch = "flatly",
  primary = "#47475c",
  secondary = "#73738c",
  success = "#a3edba",
  bg = "#f7f8fb",
  fg = "#47475c"
)

set.seed(123)

N <- 20

x <- cumsum(rnorm(N)) + 0.5 * cumsum(runif(N))
x <- round(200 * x)

df <- data.frame(
  x = sort(as.Date(Sys.time() - lubridate::days(1:N))),
  y = abs(x)
)
